featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: Great gym with a motivating atmosphere and well-maintained equipment. A special shoutout to Aryan, one of the trainers, who brings a lot of energy and enthusiasm to the floor. Despite being young, he's knowledgeable, approachable, and always ready to help with form corrections and workout tips. The gym stays clean, has good ventilation, a solid range of machines and free weights, and a positive crowd that makes training enjoyable. Overall, a great place to work on your fitness goals.

featured_reviews.name: Mahek Shahani
featured_reviews.review_text: Working out at Waves Gym under the guidance of personal trainer Amit Paste has been a game changer in my fitness routine! A highly qualified trainer, extremely professional and the workout plans are packed with high energy while he pays attention to correct form, posture and ensures all exercises are done effectively. Thanks to Amit, I can note a remarkable difference in my endurance levels and overall strength. Each session is challenging yet well structured and tailor- made for a positive performance with effective use of all machinery and equipment available at Waves Gym. My transformation has been noticed by others as well! Highly recommend trainer Amit Paste to anyone looking for a dedicated fitness coach who delivers real results.

featured_reviews.name: Rishita Panchal Jani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I signed up for their only morning batch for Studio Cycling class and seems like there was some confusion regarding the slots when I arrived. However, my session was done, all thanks to the owner, Deepak Lalvani. And just today by evening, they added an extra class at 7 am as well! It was really impressive how soon they turned their patrons’ feedback into action! Big thanks!

I had signed up for the gym membership through Shakir Khan and he did a great job of supporting me through the trial class and the membership.

As for the class, Shaurat really pumps up the energy of the class and after the class, I knew this was something I wanted in place of running in Mumbai heat.

Looking forward to the next session!

featured_reviews.name: Pritam Soni
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been training under Prabhu Sir for the past 4 years, and the experience has been absolutely transformative. He is extremely knowledgeable in CrossFit and weight training, and every session is well-structured, challenging, and safe.
What truly stands out is Prabhu Sir’s deep understanding of weight loss and body transformation. His guidance goes beyond workouts, focusing on proper form, consistency, conditioning, and long-term lifestyle improvement. Training plans are always customized based on individual goals, fitness levels, and limitations.
Over the years, I’ve seen consistent improvements in my strength, endurance, and fat loss. The motivation, discipline, and confidence I’ve gained under Prabhu Sir’s coaching are invaluable.
I highly recommend Prabhu Sir to anyone serious about CrossFit, strength training, and sustainable weight loss.

featured_reviews.name: Shadow
featured_reviews.review_text: Waves Gym is absolutely amazing! The trainers are incredibly helpful, knowledgeable, and bring such great energy every single session. The vibe here is unmatched — professional equipment, InBody testing, Normatec therapy, and a full lineup of classes including Studio Cycling, Yoga, Zumba, and HIIT. This place has everything you need and more. I absolutely love working out here! Especially prabhu sir he is amazing, very insightful and very helpful. Would 100% recommend him for any newcomers.

featured_reviews.name: Santosh Murthy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great Gym in Andheri West.
I used to workout here for nearly 3 years.
Very well qualified fitness trainers on the floor to guide you achieve the fitness goals.
Amazing facilities like great shower area, steam and changing rooms.
Not to mention that during the pandemic, they used to sanitise and cleanse the equipments regularly to ensure members safety.
Group classes are amazing too.

Overall amazing gym.

featured_reviews.name: Tanya Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: Just wanted to give a shoutout to Trainer Firoz. He’s been incredible with my training — professional, motivating, and really knows how to tailor workouts. It’s clear why your gym has such good reviews. Please pass on my appreciation to him!

featured_reviews.name: Dipen Hindocha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Waves Gym is an amazing place to train! Both indoor and outdoor workout areas are top-notch, and they have all the latest upgraded equipment needed for every kind of training. The environment is motivating and well-maintained, making workouts enjoyable every day.

A big shoutout to trainer Firoz Sir – he’s been excellent since day one. His techniques and guidance are outstanding. Truly grateful for his constant support and motivation!
Highly Recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience at *My Fitness Home* has been truly outstanding, and a big part of that credit goes to trainer **Krishna Bandekar**. From day one, the environment has been welcoming, clean, and motivating, making it easy to stay consistent with workouts. Krishna sir is extremely knowledgeable, patient, and supportive. He understands individual fitness levels and designs personalized workout plans that are both challenging and effective.

What I appreciate most is his focus on proper form, injury prevention, and overall health rather than just quick results. He constantly motivates and pushes you to do better while ensuring workouts remain safe and enjoyable. The progress I’ve seen in my strength, stamina, and confidence is amazing.

*My Fitness Home* is perfect for anyone looking for personal attention and real results. I highly recommend this place to anyone serious about improving their fitness under expert guidance.
